steps.text: Each player takes a Command Terminal board
Starting Action Deck: 2 Damage 1, 3 Reactor, 2 Shield, 2 Thruster, 1 Miss; shuffle on the left of your Terminal
Shuffle the Ship Parts facedown on the Armory; {n} faceup in 2 rows of 3
Shuffle the Crew facedown on the Armory; {n} faceup in a row
Each player takes {n} Credits; the rest in the "1" and "3" piles on the Armory
Dispatch Board across from the Armory
Shuffle the Contracts facedown; {n} faceup in 2 rows of 4 left of the board
steps.note: Shuffle back any with 3 or 4 Hazard Dice and redraw

steps.text: Deal 3 Objectives each; keep 2 secretly, the 3rd to the bottom of the deck
Hazard Dice on or near the Dispatch Board
Ship Tokens on 0 of the Prestige Tracker
First to 10 Prestige at the end of any turn wins
Objectives stay secret until fulfilled (1 Prestige each)
Everyone rolls all 4 Hazard Dice; least Hazard is the first Mission Leader (reroll ties)
